hierarchy.use: Determines where product was actually found. PRIMARY evidence.
hierarchy.limitation: Depends on MRI coverage — does not cover categories not yet audited.

hierarchy.use: Determines what the product IS. Required to establish expected category.
hierarchy.limitation: Probabilistic. Ambiguous titles yield UNKNOWN product type → UNRESOLVED.

hierarchy.use: Maps canonical product type to expected marketplace commercial category.
hierarchy.limitation: Derived from real mri_categories names. Does not cover all product types per marketplace.

hierarchy.use: Maps sub-category names (e.g. 'Poleras') to parent corridor (e.g. 'Poleras y Blusas').
hierarchy.limitation: Requires manual maintenance when marketplace adds new sub-categories.

hierarchy.use: Can be used as a HINT only. Never as final truth.
hierarchy.limitation: LEGACY_CONFIGURED_CATEGORY is provenance metadata, not a commercial taxonomy decision.

rule: Legacy configured category is NEVER used automatically as expected category. It can only be used as supporting evidence.
